topic: bus accident kills two in Mymensingh
headline_marked: 2 killed, 10 injured as [[bus hits 3 vehicles]] in Mymensingh
headline: 2 killed, 10 injured as bus hits 3 vehicles in Mymensingh
summary: The accident occurred on the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway in Trishal upazila when a bus attempted to overtake another vehicle.
details: Two people were killed and 10 others injured when a bus hit three vehicles from behind in the Kazirshimla area of Trishal upazila, Mymensingh.
The victims, both male passengers of a CNG-run auto-rickshaw, were declared dead at the Trishal Upazila Health Complex.
According to Trishal Police Station OC Monsur Ahammad, the accident happened around 7:15 am when a Mymensingh-bound bus from Dhaka hit two human haulers and a CNG auto-rickshaw while overtaking.
The injured passengers were initially taken to the Trishal Upazila Health Complex and later referred to Mymensingh Medical College Hospital for further treatment.
Police have seized the bus involved in the crash, but the driver managed to flee the scene.
A legal case has been filed in connection with the incident, confirmed the police officer.
caption:
A morning commute turns tragic as a bus hits three vehicles on the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway, leaving 2 dead and 10 injured.

Two people were killed and 10 others injured when a bus hit three vehicles from behind in the Kazirshimla area of Trishal upazila, Mymensingh.

The victims, both male passengers of a CNG-run auto-rickshaw, were declared dead at the Trishal Upazila Health Complex.

According to Trishal Police Station OC Monsur Ahammad, the accident happened around 7:15 am when a Mymensingh-bound bus from Dhaka hit two human haulers and a CNG auto-rickshaw while overtaking.

The injured passengers were initially taken to the Trishal Upazila Health Complex and later referred to Mymensingh Medical College Hospital for further treatment.

Police have seized the bus involved in the crash, but the driver managed to flee the scene.

A legal case has been filed in connection with the incident, confirmed the police officer.

topic: Dhaka ranks 4th in global air quality index
headline_marked: Air Quality Crisis: [[Dhaka ranks 4th in global air quality index]]
headline: Air Quality Crisis: Dhaka ranks 4th in global air quality index
summary: The capital city faces severe pollution levels as it climbs to one of the top five most polluted cities globally.
details: Dhaka has been ranked 4th in the global air quality index, highlighting a critical level of air pollution in the city.
The ranking reflects the current state of air quality, placing the capital among the most polluted urban centers in the world.
High levels of particulate matter and pollutants continue to affect the health and visibility of millions of residents.
Authorities and environmental experts have long called for stricter emission controls and a reduction in urban dust to combat the crisis.
